THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
WINTER PASSAGE
026
32 / Ivory Fur
A low-angle portrait under a pale winter sky: a
voluminous cream-and-tan faux-fur hat, long wind-tossed black
hair, dark berry-brown lips and a black fuzzy turtleneck. Muted,
desaturated cool tones.
33 / Snow Mink
A portrait on a snowy mountain trail: a round tan faux-fur
hat, long wavy dark hair, a gray turtleneck, a camel wool
oversized-collar coat, bright red lips and rosy cheeks with light
freckles. Snowy cliffs and bare trees behind.
